usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all network interfaces on a specific node — bridges, bonds, physical NICs, VLANs, and OVS types — useful before attaching a VM network device or diagnosing connectivity. The node must be online; the response reflects the running config parsed from /etc/network/interfaces, which may differ from a pending (not-yet-applied) config. No special privilege beyond basic cluster membership is required ('user: all').

examples.summary: List only Linux bridge interfaces on node pve1

tips: Omit the 'type' filter to get every interface in a single call; filter client-side if you need multiple types.
Check the 'active' field to distinguish interfaces that are up versus those defined but not yet applied (pending 'ifreload -a').
The 'exists' field indicates whether the interface physically exists on the OS; a false value means it is defined in config only.
Use 'any_bridge' or 'any_local_bridge' as the type filter to capture both standard Linux bridges and OVSBridges in one query.
